decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release-note entry [ev-aa8e5dfab881]. It says the Crossplane CLI can now render default values from an XRD, and otherwise only links to PR #6161. It doesn't name the CLI command or flag involved, and it doesn't say whether the defaults are applied automatically or need opting into, so neither the subject nor a before/after change can be typed. It also says nothing about which environments or workflows are affected. Answering these needs the PR description or the CLI documentation, and neither has been cited.
